title: The desk can never see whether the MettleUp Plus lock is on
what: The lock card has a read-only version for the desk, with its own words. But the card is drawn only on the owner's Member app tab, and a desk person always gets the short Settings page, which leaves the card out. So the desk cannot tell a member whether the paid extras will lock.
expected: A desk person sees the lock card in read-only form, or the unused desk words are removed.
fix_line: Show the read-only lock card on the desk Settings page

title: A receipt number that is not sure yet can still be sent to the member on WhatsApp
what: When a payment was saved while the internet dropped, the receipt page greys out Print and says the receipt number is sure only once it is sent. The Send on WhatsApp button has no such check: once the internet is back it shows, and its message carries the receipt number.
expected: Send on WhatsApp is held back, like Print, until the payment is confirmed.
how_often: after a save with no internet
fix_line: Hide the WhatsApp button while the payment is not confirmed
